description: Ministry of Health - 1st Amendment of Service Minute of the Public Health Management Assistants Service
categorisation: This gazette notification amends the service minute for Public Health Management Assistants, specifically addressing efficiency bar examinations and certificate course requirements for public service officers. It deals with public service recruitment, training requirements, and career progression matters, which falls under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) as it concerns public sector service conditions and administrative procedures rather than government structure/personnel changes.
